description.text: Sign-in for the MVC client. azuread wires Microsoft Entra ID (Microsoft.Identity.Web) with a global authorize filter.
Optional Sentry.AspNetCore integration. Leave Sentry:Dsn empty to disable sending.
tables = Azure Storage (Azurite in Development). postgres / sqlserver = EF Core via Aspire. efcore is an alias for postgres.
Add a Worker project (refs ServiceDefaults/Business/Common/Data) wired into AppHost alongside the Client.
